title: Cancer Diagnoses in England Reach New Record High
subtitle: While early detection is improving, the health service continues to struggle with waiting time targets.

summary.en: New data shows that cancer diagnoses in England have reached a record high of over 1,000 cases per day. NHS officials highlight progress in catching the disease at earlier stages. However, experts warn that the health service is still failing to meet important waiting time goals. The rise in cases is linked to an ageing population and lifestyle factors like obesity. Health leaders are calling for more government support to ensure patients receive timely care.
summary.zh: 最新數據顯示，英格蘭的癌症確診人數達到每天超過一千例的歷史新高。英國國家醫療保健服務官員強調在早期發現疾病方面取得的進展。然而，專家警告醫療服務仍未能達到重要的等待時間目標。病例增加與人口老化及肥胖等生活型態因素有關。醫療領袖正呼籲政府提供更多支持，以確保病患能獲得及時的照護。

paragraphs.en: New official figures reveal that cancer diagnoses in England have hit a record high, with more than 1,000 people receiving a diagnosis every single day. According to The Guardian Health, this marks a significant increase from previous years, with over 373,000 people diagnosed in 2024 alone. This update follows recent reports confirming that the demand for cancer services continues to grow across the country.
paragraphs.zh: 最新的官方數據顯示，英格蘭的癌症確診人數創下歷史新高，平均每天有超過一千人被診斷出罹患癌症。根據《衛報健康》（The Guardian Health）報導，這比往年有顯著增加，僅二〇二四年就有超過三十七萬三千人確診。這項更新消息是在近期報告證實全國對癌症醫療服務的需求持續成長後所發布的。

paragraphs.en: Prostate, breast, lung, and bowel cancers make up half of all new cases identified. While the high number of diagnoses is concerning, there is some positive news regarding how early the disease is found. The Guardian Health reports that 56.7% of new cancers were caught at stage 1 or 2 in 2024, an improvement compared to the previous year. Prof Peter Johnson, the NHS national clinical director for cancer, stated that these figures show the health service is moving in the right direction. He credited the hard work of NHS staff who are bringing tests and checks closer to the communities that need them most.
paragraphs.zh: 攝護腺癌、乳癌、肺癌與大腸癌占了所有新確診病例的一半。雖然確診人數之多令人擔憂，但在疾病早期發現方面仍有一些正面消息。《衛報健康》指出，二〇二四年有百分之五十六點七的新增癌症病例是在第一期或第二期被發現，較前一年有所進步。英國國家醫療保健服務（NHS）癌症國家臨床主任強森教授（Prof Peter Johnson）表示，這些數據顯示醫療服務正朝正確方向邁進。他將此歸功於醫療人員的辛勤工作，他們將檢測與檢查服務帶入最需要的社區之中。

paragraphs.en: Despite these improvements in detection, experts are urging caution. The NHS is currently struggling to meet its official timescale targets for both diagnosis and treatment. According to The Guardian Health, only 78.6% of patients urgently referred for suspected cancer were diagnosed or had the disease ruled out within 28 days in August, which is below the 80% target. The situation is even more difficult regarding treatment. Only 71.9% of patients began their treatment within 62 days of an urgent referral, significantly missing the 85% goal set by the health service.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管在檢測方面有所改善，專家仍呼籲應保持謹慎。目前英國國家醫療保健服務在診斷與治療的官方時程目標上仍面臨挑戰。根據《衛報健康》報導，八月份僅有百分之七十八點六的疑似癌症緊急轉診病患在二十八天內完成診斷或排除罹癌，低於百分之八十的目標。治療方面的狀況更為嚴峻，僅有百分之七十一點九的病患在緊急轉診後的六十二天內開始治療，遠低於醫療服務設定的百分之八十五目標。

paragraphs.en: Several factors are contributing to this rise in cancer cases. Dr Hilary Williams, a clinical vice-president at the Royal College of Physicians, noted that an ageing population is a major reason for the increase. She also highlighted that obesity remains a significant, yet often ignored, risk factor for developing cancer. Dr Williams emphasized that the NHS must continue to improve early detection methods, such as expanding lung cancer screening programs, to help more people survive.
paragraphs.zh: 多項因素導致癌症病例增加。英國皇家內科醫師學會（Royal College of Physicians）臨床副會長威廉斯醫師（Dr Hilary Williams）指出，人口老化是病例增加的主要原因。她也強調，肥胖仍是罹患癌症的一項重大且常被忽視的風險因素。威廉斯醫師強調，英國國家醫療保健服務必須持續改進早期檢測方法，例如擴大肺癌篩檢計畫，以協助更多人存活。

paragraphs.en: There is also a growing concern about fairness in healthcare. Steven McIntosh from Macmillan Cancer Support pointed out that the national figures often hide persistent health inequalities. He explained that a person’s background and where they live can still have a big impact on their risk of getting cancer and how quickly they receive a diagnosis.
paragraphs.zh: 醫療保健的公平性也日益受到關注。來自麥克米倫癌症支援組織（Macmillan Cancer Support）的麥金托什（Steven McIntosh）指出，全國性數據往往掩蓋了持續存在的健康不平等問題。他解釋說，個人的背景與居住地仍會對罹癌風險以及獲得診斷的速度產生重大影響。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, there is a clear call for more government action. Dr Ian Walker of Cancer Research UK noted that while staff are working hard to diagnose more people, too many patients are still being caught at a late stage. He argued that the UK government must keep its focus on the national cancer plan to ensure that patients are not let down. According to The Guardian Health, this requires a clear commitment to providing the NHS with the specialist staff and modern equipment necessary to handle the rising demand. Without focused effort and better accountability, experts warn that the health service will continue to struggle to meet the needs of those facing a cancer diagnosis.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，各界明確呼籲政府採取更多行動。英國癌症研究協會（Cancer Research UK）的沃克醫師（Dr Ian Walker）指出，儘管醫護人員正努力診斷更多病患，但仍有太多病患在晚期才被發現。他主張英國政府必須持續關注國家癌症計畫，以確保病患不會被辜負。根據《衛報健康》報導，這需要政府明確承諾為英國國家醫療保健服務提供處理日益增長的需求所需的專業人員與現代化設備。專家警告，若沒有集中的努力與更好的問責制度，醫療服務將持續難以滿足那些面臨癌症診斷的病患需求。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To reach a specific level or number.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「打擊」，這裡指數據達到新高。文中：New official figures reveal that cancer diagnoses in England have hit a record high, with more than 1,000 people receiving a diagnosis every single day.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To discover or detect a disease at a particular stage.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「捕捉」，這裡指醫療檢測發現疾病。文中：The Guardian Health reports that 56.7% of new cancers were caught at stage 1 or 2 in 2024, an improvement compared to the previous year.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To decide that something is not possible or is not the cause of a problem.
keyTerms.noteZh: 由 rule 和 out 組成，意思與字面拆解不同。文中：According to The Guardian Health, only 78.6% of patients urgently referred for suspected cancer were diagnosed or had the disease ruled out within 28 days in August, which is below the 80% target.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To fail to support or help someone as they expected.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「放下」，這裡指未能提供應有的幫助。文中：He argued that the UK government must keep its focus on the national cancer plan to ensure that patients are not let down.

previousArticles.title: Cancer Diagnoses in England Reach Record High
previousArticles.summaryEn: Recent data reveals that cancer diagnoses in England have reached a record high of over 1,000 cases per day. While health officials note improvements in early detection, the NHS is struggling to meet its official waiting time targets for diagnosis and treatment. Experts point to an ageing population and lifestyle factors as key drivers behind the rising numbers. There are also concerns regarding health inequalities, where a person's background or location can affect their care. The government is now under pressure to provide more support and resources to the health service.

quiz.question: What is the status of the NHS regarding its cancer treatment targets as of August?

options.A: It has successfully met the 85% goal for treatment initiation.
options.B: It is performing better in treatment than in initial diagnosis.
options.C: It failed to meet the 80% target for the 28-day diagnosis timeline.
options.D: It has exceeded all government targets for cancer services.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第三段，8月份只有 78.6% 的患者在 28 天內完成診斷或排除疾病，低於 80% 的目標。選項 A 錯誤，因為治療目標（62天內開始治療）僅達成 71.9%，遠低於 85% 的目標。選項 B 錯誤，因為 71.9% 的治療達成率低於 78.6% 的診斷達成率。選項 D 與事實完全相反，NHS 目前正面臨無法達成目標的困境。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, what can be inferred about the current state of cancer care in England?

options.A: The increase in cancer cases is primarily due to a lack of modern medical equipment.
options.B: Early detection is improving, but the system is struggling to process the rising volume of patients.
options.C: The NHS has successfully eliminated health inequalities across different regions.
options.D: Patients are now waiting longer for diagnosis than they were in previous years.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文章第二段提到早期診斷（第1、2期）比例有所提升（56.7%），顯示早期檢測進步；然而第三段指出 NHS 在診斷與治療的時間目標上持續落後，顯示系統因需求增加而負荷過重。選項 A 錯誤，文中提到老化與肥胖是主因，而非設備不足。選項 C 錯誤，第五段明確指出健康不平等現象依然存在。選項 D 無法從文中推論，文中僅提到目前的達成率數據，未直接比較歷年等待時間的長短。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the word 'accountability' mean in the context of the NHS struggling to meet its needs?

options.A: The obligation to accept responsibility for actions and results.
options.B: The act of counting the total number of cancer patients.
options.C: The process of providing financial aid to medical staff.
options.D: The ability to predict future trends in healthcare.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。Accountability 在此處指「問責制」或「責任歸屬」，意指政府與醫療體系必須對其表現與成效負責。選項 B 是對字根的誤解，並非計算人數。選項 C 雖涉及資源，但非該詞定義。選項 D 雖與規劃有關，但 accountability 強調的是對結果負責，而非預測能力。在醫療政策語境下，這通常指確保政策執行並對成效負責。

quiz.question: What is the central message of this article?

options.A: The NHS is successfully reducing cancer rates through new government policies.
options.B: Obesity and an ageing population are the only factors causing the rise in cancer.
options.C: Cancer diagnoses are rising, and despite better early detection, the NHS faces significant operational challenges.
options.D: The government has decided to prioritize lung cancer screening to solve the current crisis.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。本文開頭點出癌症診斷數創新高，隨後討論了早期檢測的進步（正面），但緊接著指出 NHS 在診斷與治療時效上的困難（負面），並總結了專家對政府行動的需求。選項 A 錯誤，文中並未提到癌症發生率下降，反而是上升。選項 B 錯誤，文中提到這是主要原因之一，但非「唯一」原因。選項 D 錯誤，肺癌篩檢僅是專家建議改善的方法之一，並非解決整個危機的唯一方案。
